<!-- Add Description Below -->
There is currently no standardized guidance for health policy reports required by federal law in the United States of America; we introduce the first reporting guideline tailored to Congressionally Mandated Reports (CMRs).   

Our guideline advances implementation science by applying standards to legislation and health related policy-driven reporting and supports the uptake of research findings into real-world settings and to the public. 

We identify common gaps and inconsistencies across federal reports, highlighting barriers to clear evidence use, transparency, and public accessibility.   

The framework offers a practical checklist to enhance the transparency, consistency, and usability of CMRs for scientists, policymakers, editorial boards, universities, and international organizations.
